# The meadow: one 16 x 13 m plane, grass with dark tufts and yellow flowers painted in a
# palette-exact 64 x 52 texture (0.25 m a texel). Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
add mesh grid --name Ground --size 1 --x-subdivisions 8 --y-subdivisions 8 --location 0 0 0
scale 16 13 1
apply --scale
material new Grass --base-color 1 1 1
material assign Grass
active Ground
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Grass base-color textures/grass.png
shade flat
export ground.glb
